PRIVACY: Everyone who opens this page can see the position of {name}.
Your own position is visible only to you. The page does not send it anywhere or store it on the server.
The map and the map library are loaded from external servers (OpenStreetMap, cdnjs). They can see your device's IP address and the part of the map you are viewing.
The server hosting this page keeps standard access logs (e.g. IP address and time), like any web server.
If you enable the compass, the direction you are facing is used only on your phone.
